name: kestra
description: Write, harden, migrate and operate Kestra flows, grounded in the live Kestra plugin schema and docs.

interface.longDescription: Kestra is an open-source, event-driven orchestration platform. This plugin lets ChatGPT and Codex write schema-valid Kestra flow YAML, audit and harden existing flows for production, migrate Airflow DAGs to Kestra, and guide a Kestra 1.3 to 2.0 upgrade. In Codex, the kestra-ops skill also validates and deploys flows and runs executions through kestractl.
defaultPrompt: Use Kestra to write a flow that pulls a REST API every hour and loads the result into Postgres.
Use Kestra to harden this flow for production.
Use Kestra to migrate this Airflow DAG to a Kestra flow.
